description: The configuration surface of the feeds chart. GENERATED from values.yaml by `./build.sh Charts` and diffed in CI — docs/plan/03 § charts/. Edit values.yaml, never this file. Members carrying `x-cybercloud-api: false` are chart or platform plumbing and are not part of the resource body.

description.description: What the feed is for, shown in the portal beside its name.

kind.description: Which protocol the feed speaks: nuget (the v3 API), npm (the registry API) or maven (the repository layout). Immutable, because the three have three versioning models.

platform.description: Resource identity, for NOTES.txt. Not a tenant-facing setting.

feedsHost.description: The origin CyberCloud.Registry.Feeds.Host is reachable at — CyberCloud:Feeds:PublicBaseUri on that host, which is what a service index and a tarball URL are spelled with.
feedsHost.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Supplied by whoever installs the chart, for NOTES.txt alone — a feed's reconciler renders nothing and reads none of this. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

name.description: The feed's own name — the fourth segment of every feed URL.
name.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Supplied by whoever installs the chart, for NOTES.txt alone — a feed's reconciler renders nothing and reads none of this. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

resourceGroup.description: Resource group name — the third segment of every feed URL.
resourceGroup.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Supplied by whoever installs the chart, for NOTES.txt alone — a feed's reconciler renders nothing and reads none of this. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

subscriptionId.description: Subscription GUID — the second segment of every feed URL.
